candidates.summary: Civil Estimator for Earthworks preparing cost estimates for civil construction projects.
candidates.opening:
About the role
The successful candidate will be responsible for preparing accurate and competitive cost estimates for civil construction projects from tender stage through to project award. The role involves reviewing drawings and specifications, completing quantity take-offs, obtaining subcontractor and supplier pricing, assessing project risks, and developing detailed tender submissions.
Key responsibilities
- Review tender documentation, construction drawings, specifications, schedules and scope of works.
- Prepare detailed quantity take-offs and cost estimates for labour, materials, plant, subcontractors and equipment.
- Develop estimates for civil works including earthworks, drainage, underground services, roads, pavements, concrete works and associated infrastructure.
- Obtain and evaluate quotations from subcontractors and suppliers.
- Prepare requests for quotations and clearly d
key_lines: - Develop construction methodologies and determine appropriate labour and equipment requirements.
- Calculate production rates and assess project durations and resource requirements.
- Identify project risks, opportunities, exclusions, qualifications and potential cost impacts.
- Experience in civil construction estimating or a related civil construction role essential.
- Experience obtaining and analysing subcontractor and supplier quotations.
